corrections.reason: The second character in በዚሁች has the clear horizontal right-side stroke of 2nd-order ሁ (archaic Andemta form በዚሁች), misread as 1st-order ሀ.
2nd-person masculine singular ending ሳለህ is printed with 6th-order ህ, misread as 1st-order ሀ.
2nd-person masculine singular verb ending ትኖራለህ is printed with 6th-order ህ, misread as 1st-order ሀ.
The glyph in ወደዚሁች has the right-side mid-stroke of 2nd-order ሁ (matching በዚሁች in Col 1 L19), misread as ሀ.
